title: Mandala Colouring Book for Adults – 50 Single-Sided Designs
description:
Fifty mandala patterns, from simple starter circles to highly detailed designs, each printed on one side only so markers never spoil the next page.
• Format: A4 (21 x 29.7 cm) paperback, 104 pages
• Paper: 120 gsm bright white, suitable for coloured pencils, fineliners and gel pens
• Perforated pages for easy removal and framing
• Colour test page at the back; colouring tools not included

title: Floral Patterns Colouring Book for Adults – 40 Illustrations
description:
Forty hand-drawn illustrations of flowers, leaves and flowing patterns for an unhurried evening with your pencils or markers.
• Format: 25 x 25 cm square paperback, 88 pages
• Paper: 140 gsm smooth cartridge paper, printed on one side
• Mix of bold outlines and fine details for different skill levels
• Colouring tools not included

title: Ocean & Mermaid Colouring Book for Kids – 64 Pages, Ages 4+
description:
Bold, simple outlines of mermaids, sea creatures and underwater scenes, sized just right for small hands and chunky crayons.
• Format: A4 paperback, 64 pages with 60 illustrations
• Thick outlines and large spaces suited to crayons and felt-tip pens
• 100 gsm paper with one picture per page
• Recommended for ages 4+

title: Reusable Sticker Activity Book – Vehicles & Building Site, Ages 3+
description:
Children create busy roads and construction scenes with peel-and-stick vinyl stickers that can be lifted and moved again and again.
• 12 illustrated background scenes on wipeable card pages
• Over 150 reusable vinyl stickers of diggers, trucks, bikes and road signs
• Spiral-bound A5 landscape format that lies flat on the table
• Ages 3+. Warning: not suitable for children under 36 months, small parts

title: Preschool Tracing & Activity Workbook – 100 Pages, Ages 3+
description:
A colourful first workbook with tracing lines, shapes, numbers 1–20, simple mazes and spot-the-difference pages for practising pencil control before school.
• Format: A4 paperback, 100 full-colour pages
• Activities progress from simple lines to letters and numbers
• Includes a sheet of reward stickers
• Ages 3+; use with pencils or crayons

title: Drawing & Doodle Prompt Book for Kids – 120 Ideas, Ages 6+
description:
Half-finished pictures and playful prompts, such as finishing the monster or filling the aquarium, to get young artists drawing on rainy days and long journeys.
• Format: 20 x 20 cm paperback, 128 pages
• 120 prompts with plenty of blank space on every page
• 120 gsm paper suitable for pencils, crayons and felt-tips
• Ages 6+

title: Mixed Puzzle Book for Adults – 200 Crosswords, Word Searches and Number Puzzles
description:
A chunky variety book that mixes classic crosswords, word searches, number grids and logic puzzles, so there is always something different on the next page.
• 200 puzzles in English, graded from easy to challenging
• A5 paperback, 240 pages, with full solutions at the back
• Matt, non-glare paper that is pleasant to write on in pencil or pen
• Handy size for travel, waiting rooms and coffee breaks

title: Large-Print Crossword Book – 100 Puzzles with Solutions
description:
Easy-to-read crosswords with large clue text and roomy grid squares, printed on bright white paper for comfortable solving.
• 100 crosswords in English, one puzzle per page
• A4 paperback, 128 pages; clues set in 16 pt type
• Grid squares approx. 1 cm wide for easy writing
• Solutions included at the back

title: Maze Puzzle Book for Kids – 100 Mazes, Ages 5+
description:
One hundred mazes that get trickier page by page, from simple paths to twisting labyrinths, with answers at the back.
• Format: A4 paperback, 112 pages
• Four difficulty levels from beginner to expert
• Black-and-white mazes that can be coloured in afterwards
• Ages 5+

title: A5 Hardcover Dotted Notebook with Elastic Band – 160 Pages
description:
A sturdy dot-grid notebook for planning, sketching or everyday notes, with thick paper that keeps most pens from showing through.
• Size: A5 (14.8 x 21 cm), 160 numbered pages with a 5 mm dot grid
• Paper: 120 gsm ivory, with index pages at the front
• Lay-flat binding, two ribbon markers, elastic closure and an inner back pocket
• Hardcover in a soft linen-look finish

title: Undated Weekly Planner, A5 – 52 Weeks with Monthly Overviews
description:
Start any time of year: an undated planner with monthly calendars, weekly spreads and room for goals, habits and to-do lists.
• Size: A5, 176 pages of 100 gsm paper
• 12 monthly overviews and 52 two-page weekly spreads
• Habit tracker, notes pages and a ribbon bookmark
• Flexible soft-touch cover with rounded corners

title: Faux-Leather Travel Journal with Wrap Cord, Refillable A6
description:
A rustic travel journal with a soft faux-leather cover that wraps closed with a long cord, holding refillable notebooks for tickets, notes and sketches.
• Cover: PU leather, approx. 12 x 17 cm when closed
• Comes with two A6 notebook inserts of 64 sheets each, one plain and one lined
• Wrap-around cord with a metal charm and two inner card slots
• Takes standard A6 refill inserts

title: Abstract Boho Wall Art Prints – Set of 6, 20 x 25 cm, Unframed
description:
Six coordinating prints in warm earthy tones and soft abstract shapes, designed to hang together as a ready-made gallery wall above a sofa or bed.
• Set of 6 prints, each 20 x 25 cm
• Printed on 250 gsm matt art paper
• Frames not included; fits standard 20 x 25 cm frames
• Shipped flat in a rigid card envelope

title: Geometric Abstract Poster, 50 x 70 cm, Unframed
description:
A bold mid-century style composition of overlapping shapes that adds colour and structure to a living room, hallway or home office.
• Size: 50 x 70 cm
• Printed on 200 gsm silk-finish poster paper
• Frame not included; fits standard 50 x 70 cm frames
• Rolled in a sturdy cardboard tube for delivery

title: Minimalist Line Art Prints – Set of 3, A4, Unframed
description:
Three simple single-line drawings of a face, a leafy branch and a vase, printed in black on warm white paper for a calm, modern look.
• Set of 3 prints, each A4 (21 x 29.7 cm)
• 250 gsm matt paper
• Frames not included; suits standard A4 frames
• Shipped flat with a stiff card backing

title: Magnetic Bookmarks Set – 12 Pieces in Assorted Colours
description:
Slim folding bookmarks with magnets inside that clip over the page and stay put, even when your book is tossed into a bag.
• Set of 12, each approx. 2.5 x 6 cm when folded
• Laminated card with thin magnets sealed inside
• Assorted colours and patterns
• Keep away from children under 3 years: contains small magnets

title: Wooden Bookmarks with Tassel – Set of 4 Engraved Designs
description:
Thin wooden bookmarks laser-engraved with nature motifs and finished with a cotton tassel, a small gift for anyone who loves to read.
• Set of 4 designs: fern, moon, mountain and wildflower
• Material: 2 mm birch plywood; size approx. 15 x 4 cm
• Cotton tassels in assorted colours
• Wipe clean with a dry cloth

title: Adjustable Bamboo Book Stand with Page Holders
description:
A folding stand that holds cookbooks, textbooks or tablets at a comfortable reading angle, leaving your hands free for cooking, typing or taking notes.
• Material: solid bamboo; folds flat for storage
• Six angle settings; base approx. 33 x 24 cm
• Two spring-loaded page holders keep the book open
• Holds books up to approx. 5 cm thick

title: Wooden Vinyl Record Rack – Holds up to 50 LPs
description:
A tabletop record holder with open slatted sides, so you can flip through your LP collection just like in a record shop.
• Material: lacquered pine wood
• Holds up to 50 records of 12 inches (30 cm)
• Size: approx. 40 x 28 x 25 cm; flat-packed, with fittings included
• Also works for magazines and large picture books

title: Freestanding CD & DVD Storage Tower – Holds 100 CDs
description:
A slim media tower that keeps CDs, DVDs and game cases neatly upright, with adjustable shelves to fit different case sizes.
• Material: black MDF with a matt finish
• Holds approx. 100 CDs or 60 DVDs on 5 adjustable shelves
• Size: approx. 20 x 17 x 90 cm; wall anchor included for extra stability
• Self-assembly, with fittings and instructions included
